You've invited a group of classmates to your birthday, but a few have not yet said if they're coming. Why haven't they said something yet? 
 
They don't know yet if they can come or not. 

On a scale of 1-5, how likely is this thought to pop into your mind?

buttons: 1::1: Doesn't pop up in my mind
3::3: Might pop up in my mind
5::5: Definitely pops up in my mind
